content.user_title: Analyze Chinese Data Policy and Opportunities
content.value_statement: Changing Chinese data policies create compliance uncertainty and missed opportunities. This skill structures policy analysis, opportunity assessment, application planning, and policy tracking.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes policy text through text, intent, impact, opportunity, and risk layers.
Classifies opportunities as funding, pilot, qualification, or market opportunities.
Builds policy registers with document numbers, dates, levels, key points, impacts, and status.
Assesses application readiness across eligibility, project design, evidence, team capability, and material quality.
Drafts policy reports, impact analyses, opportunity lists, training materials, and application checklists.
Applies quality checks for source authority, policy validity, regional differences, and unsupported claims.
limitations: The bundled knowledge base is dated September 22, 2026, and may not reflect later changes.
The skill does not automatically browse government websites or verify current policy status.
Regional rules require separate review for the relevant province or municipality.
Outputs are not legal, regulatory, accounting, or investment advice.

use_cases.title: Assess business impact
use_cases.description: Translate a new data policy into operational changes, opportunities, risks, and accountable actions.

use_cases.title: Prepare an application
use_cases.description: Evaluate readiness for a pilot, funding program, or qualification and produce an evidence checklist.

use_cases.title: Maintain a policy register
use_cases.description: Organize relevant national and local policies into a consistent register for periodic review.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize one policy
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize [policy name] for [organization type]. Separate the policy text, policy intent, affected parties, and immediate actions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a single policy

prompt_templates.title: Run a five-layer analysis
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [policy text] using the five layers. Identify direct impacts, indirect impacts, opportunities, compliance requirements, evidence, and unresolved questions.

prompt_templates.title: Assess application readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess our readiness for [program]. Review eligibility, project design, past performance, team capability, and material quality. Produce gaps and a document checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Build a policy action portfolio
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [policy set] across national and [region] requirements. Rank impacts and opportunities, assign owners, define evidence, and create a review schedule.

output_examples.input: Analyze a public data authorization policy for a regional data service provider.
output: Direct impact: authorization procedures and operating controls require review.
Opportunity: prepare a regional authorization proposal supported by relevant delivery evidence.
Risk: local rules and current official notices must be verified before action.
Next step: assign owners for eligibility, compliance, solution design, and evidence collection.

output_examples.input: Evaluate readiness for a data asset management pilot application.
output_examples.output: The readiness review covers applicant eligibility, project scope, prior evidence, team credentials, and material quality. It identifies missing evidence and assigns preparation actions.

output_examples.input: Create a policy tracking register for data asset accounting.
output_examples.output: The register lists each policy title, document number, issuing authority, date, jurisdiction, status, key requirements, business impact, owner, and next review date.

best_practices: Provide the complete policy text, issuing authority, publication date, jurisdiction, and business context.
Verify every policy number, effective date, amendment, and local implementation rule against an official source.
Separate sourced facts from interpretation, assumptions, recommendations, and unresolved questions.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the bundled knowledge base as a live or complete policy database.
Do not present funding amounts, eligibility, approval outcomes, or timelines as guaranteed.
Do not submit invented credentials, performance records, partnerships, or supporting evidence.

faq.question: Which policies can this skill analyze?
faq.answer: It focuses on Chinese data policy, data assets, public data, data circulation, trusted data spaces, and related application programs.

faq.question: Does the skill retrieve current policies automatically?
faq.answer: No. Supply current official documents or verified links before requesting time-sensitive analysis.

faq.question: Can it compare national and local requirements?
faq.answer: Yes, when you provide the relevant national and local documents and identify the applicable jurisdiction.

faq.question: Can it guarantee a successful application?
faq.answer: No. It can assess gaps and organize materials, but agencies determine eligibility and outcomes.

faq.question: Is the output legal or investment advice?
faq.answer: No. Qualified professionals should review important legal, regulatory, accounting, and investment decisions.

faq.question: What information improves the result?
faq.answer: Provide your organization type, location, business model, target program, existing qualifications, project evidence, deadlines, and official policy text.
